CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: marksman command
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: {PAWN_nameDef} is an experienced combatant and will likely be valuable for the defense of the colony. However, if {PAWN_pronoun} turns on you, {PAWN_pronoun} would be a dangerous enemy.

CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: craftsmaster
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: {PAWN_nameDef} is an exceptional craftsman, despite {PAWN_possessive} heavy disability. While {PAWN_possessive} abilities would be useful now, replacing {PAWN_possessive} arms and legs may be necessary eventually.

CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: berserk trance
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: {PAWN_nameDef} appears passive for now, but {PAWN_pronoun} could be highly dangerous. There is rage hiding behind his expression.

CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: the gourmand
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: {PAWN_nameDef} claims to be one of the best chefs on the entire planet. {PAWN_pronoun} insists {PAWN_possessive} journey to create the most unique flavors stayed within the mundane, but it feels like a lie.

HediffDef.label: Twisted Digestion
HediffDef.description: This person has a unique relationship with their food.

CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: bioferrite body
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: {PAWN_nameDef} has had multiple body parts replaced. The modifications resemble bionics, but seem to operate through psychic phenomena. It is unlikely these parts can be transplanted to another.

HediffDef.label: bioferrite arm
HediffDef.description: A bioferrite arm. The metal is a brackish grey and sparks crackle between multiple loose segments. The limb is held together psychically. If removed, it will likely crumble apart. It is better than a biological arm in almost every way.

HediffDef.label: bioferrite leg
HediffDef.description: A bioferrite leg. The metal is a brackish grey and sparks crackle between multiple loose segments. The limb is held together psychically. If removed, it will likely crumble apart. It is better than a biological leg in almost every way.

HediffDef.label: bioferrite eye
HediffDef.description: A bioferrite eye. The metal is a brackish grey and sparks crackle between multiple loose segments. The eye interacts with the user's brain through a psychic link. If removed, it will likely crumble apart. It is better than a biological eye in almost every way.

HediffDef.label: psychic drive
HediffDef.description: This person has a psychic link to some distant archotech engine. This link increases their capabilities in all areas, but at some unknown cost.
